1
list - Ordered, Changeable, collection of multiple items that allows duplicates [].
num1 = [10,20,30]

Tuple - Tuple is same as list but not it cannot be changed once created ,cannot be added or even removed ().
num2= (10,20,30)

Set - Set(mutable) stores Unordered multiple items but it dosent allow any duplicates.It will automatically removes duplicate values{}.
num3= {10,20,30}


Dict - It stores the data in key:Value pair.Each key is used to maniplaute the data
student = {"name": "Gowtham", "marks": 95}

2

Sets -They are used to remove dplicate values in the real world

 1.Resume Filtering(Removes duplicate resumes)
 2.Website Information(Stores the data only one time if entered 2nd time it will be removed.)
 3.IDs - Creating unique id for each person

3
Ordered- Have fixed positions
Unordered - Do not have fixed positions.position can change if we print them

Mutable datatype - Values can be changed after creation.
Immutable datatype - Values cannot be changed after creation.
